AnimatedPoint.description:
A position that can move along curves between its keyframes.

Its JSON is that of an `Animated<Vec2>`, plus optional spatial tangents on
each keyframe: with them, the value travels along the cubic Bezier from
one keyframe's value through its `out_tangent` and the next keyframe's
`in_tangent`, at the speed its timing curve sets along the curve's
length. Without them it moves in a straight line, as an `Animated<Vec2>`
does.

timeline_range.description: Destination interval on the project timeline.

ClipBlendMode.description:
Artistic blend operation stored independently from a renderer implementation.

The modes are those of W3C Compositing and Blending Level 1 (the CSS
`mix-blend-mode` values), with the specification's formulas.

oneOf.description: Preserve source color and apply source-over coverage.
Multiply source and backdrop components.
Inverse-multiply source and backdrop components.
Multiply dark backdrop regions and screen light regions.
The darker of source and backdrop, per channel.
The lighter of source and backdrop, per channel.
Brighten the backdrop to reflect the source.
Darken the backdrop to reflect the source.

The source's saturation with the backdrop's hue and luminosity.

The source's luminosity with the backdrop's hue and saturation.

ClipComposition.description:
A clip's use of a [`Composition`], and how its time maps onto it.

Composition time is `offset + (t - clip start) * scale` for timeline time
`t`, rounded down to a tick. Moving a clip keeps its offset, so its
animation moves with it; trimming its start by `d` adds `d * scale` to the
offset, so what remains of the animation stays where it was. Extending the
start before composition time zero makes the offset negative: settings
hold their first keyframe there, and media nodes show their first frame.

offset.description: Composition time at the clip's start.

ClipEffect.description:
One versioned runtime effect invocation: a composition's effect or
transition node, or a timeline transition.

params.description:
Named parameter values, constant or keyframed. Omitted entries use
definition defaults.

Keyframe times are composition times in a composition node and
timeline times in a timeline transition. A parameter's keyframes all
have one value type, and `enum` and `bool` keyframes only hold. An
interpolated value that a timing curve carries past the parameter's
range is clamped to it; an authored value outside it is an error.

resources.description: Named external resources matched against the effect definition.

version.description: Exact effect definition version required by the project.

ClipTransition.description: A two-input transition over the overlap of two visual clips.

easing.description:

progress is clamped to `0..=1`, the domain transition shaders define.

effect.description: Versioned transition shader and named parameter values.

from_clip.description: Clip sampled as transition progress zero.

timeline_range.description: Half-open timeline interval over which both clips must be active.

to_clip.description: Clip sampled as transition progress one.

ColorMatrix.description: Coefficients used to decode source components.

oneOf.description: SD BT.601 YUV coefficients.

BT.2020 non-constant-luminance YUV coefficients.

dynamic_range.description:

matrix.description: YUV-to-RGB coefficient family, or RGB for already converted sources.

ColorPipeline.description:
How sources' colors come into the working space.

The working space is display-referred linear light with BT.709 primaries,
where `1.0` is SDR white (100 nits), and every export is SDR BT.709. SDR
sources decode through the sRGB EOTF; wide-gamut ones are converted into
BT.709 primaries. An HDR (PQ or HLG) source is either refused or brought
in: linearized to display light, converted into BT.709 primaries, and
tone-mapped from [`Self::hdr_peak_nits`] to SDR white by the ITU-R BT.2390
EETF on each pixel's largest component, which keeps its hue.

hdr_peak_nits.description:
The luminance, in nits, HDR sources are taken to peak at: PQ above it
is clipped to it, HLG is displayed at it, and the tone map brings it
to SDR white. Within [`HDR_PEAK_NITS_RANGE`].

oneOf.description: SD video primaries.

Generator.description:
The picture of a generated source.

A generated picture has the canvas's size and aspect, like a source that
fills the frame at scale 1. Positions are in its normalized space, `(0, 0)`

fractions of its shorter side, so the picture is the same at any render
resolution. A fill or text does not change over time (a clip animates it
with its transform, effects, and masks); shapes and layouts may.

LayoutBorder.description: A border inside the border box, as wide on every side.

paint.description: What covers the border. Positions are normalized to the border box.

LayoutInset.description:
Where an absolute box lies in its parent's padding box. A missing side is
auto: with neither `left` nor `right`, the box keeps its place in the
flow on that axis.

bottom.description: Distance from the parent's bottom padding edge.

left.description: Distance from the parent's left padding edge.

right.description: Distance from the parent's right padding edge.

top.description: Distance from the parent's top padding edge.

LayoutLength.description: A length: a number is a fraction of the layout picture's shorter side, "<n>px" pixels of the project canvas, "<n>%" a percent of the parent's content box along the field's axis.

LayoutNode.description:
One box of a layout tree.

A box lays its children out by flexbox (`display: flex`, the default) or
grid (`display: grid`). It is a container when it has children, a leaf
when it has text or shape content, and empty otherwise (a spacer or a
decoration). Per box, its background is drawn first, then its border,
then its content. Boxes are drawn in document order; a reversed
direction or a grid placement moves them, not their order.

align_content.description:
Where lines of a wrapping flex container, or a grid's rows, lie
across the container. Default `stretch`.

align_items.description:
Where children lie across the main axis, or in their grid areas'
rows. Default `stretch`.

align_self.description:
Where the box lies across its flex container's main axis, or in its
grid area's row. `None` follows the parent's `align_items`.

background.description:
What covers the border box, rounded by `border_radius`. Positions
are normalized to the border box.

border.description: A border inside the border box.

border_radius.description:
The corner radius of the border box. At least 0; default 0. A radius
past half the box's shorter side is capped.

children.description:
Boxes laid out in this one, in document (and paint) order. Not with
`text` or `shape`.

color.description: Text color. Inherited; the root's is white.

column_gap.description: Space between columns, in place of `gap`. At least 0.

display.description:
How the box lays its children out. Default `flex`. Not on a box with
text or shape content, as every container field.

flex_basis.description: The main size before growing and shrinking. `None` is auto.

flex_direction.description: The main axis of a flex container's children. Default `row`.

flex_grow.description:
How much of a flex container's free space the box takes. At least
0; default 0. Not in a grid, as every flex item field.

flex_shrink.description:
How much the box gives up when a flex container's space runs short.
At least 0; default 1.

flex_wrap.description:
Whether a flex container's children wrap onto more lines. Default
`nowrap`.

font_family.description:
The family the box's text draws in, as a text style's
`font_family`. Inherited; the root's is the host's first font.

font_size.description:
Font size: positive, at most [`MAX_LAYOUT_FONT_SIZE`] of the
picture's shorter side. Inherited; the root's is 0.05.

gap.description: Space between children, on both axes. At least 0; default 0.

grid_auto_columns.description: The size of a grid's implicit columns. Default `auto`.

grid_auto_flow.description: How a grid places items without a placement. Default `row`.

grid_auto_rows.description: The size of a grid's implicit rows. Default `auto`.

grid_column.description:
The box's columns in its grid, as CSS writes them (`2`, `"1 / 3"`,
`"span 2"`). Default `auto`.

grid_row.description: The box's rows in its grid. Default `auto`.

grid_template_columns.description:
A grid's explicit columns, as CSS writes them (`"1fr 2fr"`,
`"repeat(3, minmax(100px, 1fr))"`). Default none.

grid_template_rows.description: A grid's explicit rows. Default none.

inset.description: Where an `absolute` box lies in its parent's padding box.

justify_content.description:
Where children lie along the main (inline, for a grid) axis. Default
`start`.

justify_items.description:
Where a grid's children lie in their grid areas' columns. Default
`stretch`.

justify_self.description:
Where the box lies in its grid area's column. `None` follows the
parent's `justify_items`. Not in a flex container, as every grid
item field.

line_height.description:
Baseline-to-baseline distance in font sizes, in `[0.5, 3]`.
Inherited; the root's is 1.2.

margin.description:
Space outside the border, written as `padding` is. Sides may be
negative; there is no `auto`.

min_width.description: Smallest width. `None` is auto, the CSS automatic minimum size.

opacity.description:
Opacity of the box and everything in it, as one group, in `0..=1`.
Drawn after layout; it never moves a box.

outline.description:
A band around the glyphs; its width a fraction of the font size.
Inherited; the root has none.

overflow.description: Whether content past the padding box is drawn. Default `visible`.

padding.description:
Space inside the border: a length, the CSS shorthand
(`"8px 16px"`), or the sides object. Sides at least 0; default 0.

position.description: Whether the box is in its parent's flow. Default `relative`.

rotation_degrees.description:
Clockwise rotation of the box and everything in it about its
border-box centre, in degrees, after layout.

row_gap.description:
Space between rows (between lines of a wrapping row flex
container), in place of `gap`. At least 0.

scale.description:
Per-axis scale of the box and everything in it about its border-box
centre, after layout.

shape.description:
Shapes drawn on a picture the size of the box's content box. Not with
`children` or `text`.

text.description:
The box's text, wrapped at its content width and drawn in the style
it inherits; `\n` starts a line. At most [`MAX_TEXT_CONTENT_BYTES`]
bytes per value; may be empty. Its keyframes all `hold`. Not with
`children` or `shape`.

text_align.description:
How lines align within the content width. Inherited; the root's is
`start`.

translate.description:
Offset of the box and everything in it, after layout: the object, or
one or two lengths as CSS `translate` writes them.

width.description:
Border-box width. `None` is auto. Not on the root, as every item
field.

LayoutOffset.description: An offset, x right and y down: one or two lengths as CSS translate writes them (y 0 when missing), or {x, y}.

LayoutShape.description:
A box's shapes, drawn as a shapes generator draws its items on a picture
the size of the box's content box: positions normalized to that box,
lengths fractions of its shorter side. A shape box has no size of its
own.

LayoutSize.description: A length that may not be a percent: a number is a fraction of the layout picture's shorter side, "<n>px" pixels of the project canvas.

Limiter.description: Final peak limiter placed at the end of the master bus.

release_ms.description: Release time in milliseconds, positive and at most [`MAX_ENVELOPE_MS`].

threshold.description: Linear ceiling, positive and at most [`MAX_GAIN`]. One is full scale.

oneOf.description: Flat at the end point.
A half circle past the end point.
A half square past the end point.

LineJoin.description: How stroke segments meet at a vertex.

oneOf.description: Extended edges meeting at a point, up to the miter limit.
A circular arc.
A straight cut across the corner.

LinearPrimaries.description:
Named RGB primaries linear-light media may be in, each with its own white
point.

oneOf.description: ITU-R BT.709 and sRGB, D65 white.
ITU-R BT.2020, D65 white.
DCI-P3 primaries with a D65 white, as Display P3.
ACES AP0 (SMPTE ST 2065-1), the ACES white.
ACES AP1 (ACEScg), the ACES white.

LoopMode.description: How each pass of a [`TimeMap::Loop`] follows the one before.

oneOf.description:
Every pass plays forward, from the start again. Sound fades out and
in over [`LOOP_FADE_SECONDS`] at each wrap, so the jump does not click.
Passes alternate forward and backward.

MaskMode.description:
How a mask combines with the coverage of the masks before it.

Coverage starts empty when the first mask adds, and full otherwise, so a
clip whose only mask subtracts is visible outside the shape.

oneOf.description: Union: `c + m - c * m`.
Difference: `c * (1 - m)`.
Intersection: `c * m`.

effects.description:
Ordered single-input effects applied to the summed track buses, at
most [`MAX_CHAIN_EFFECTS`].

gain.description: Animated linear master amplitude constrained to `0..=MAX_GAIN`.

limiter.description:
Final peak limiter. An omitted field is [`Limiter::default`]; an
explicit `null` leaves the mix unlimited.

Matte.description:
Another visual clip whose picture sets where this clip is visible.

The matte clip is drawn, with its own transform and effects, only into the
matte; a clip that is any clip's matte is never composited itself. Where
the matte clip is not active, its coverage is zero.

mode.description: What of that picture is the coverage.

source.description: The clip whose picture is the matte.

MatteMode.description: Which property of the matte clip's picture is coverage.

oneOf.description: Its alpha.
One minus its alpha.
Its luminance over black: BT.709 weights on linear light, times alpha.
One minus that luminance.

MediaFingerprint.description:
Evidence of a source's media, each part recorded only when it was known.

A matching content hash proves the same bytes. Without one, the other
parts can only show a difference. `modified_ms` narrows a search for
candidates and never decides whether a candidate is the same media.

color.description: The color the decoded pictures carry.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole file, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

duration_ticks.description:
Where the media ends on its own timeline, in ticks: its first
presentation plus its length, the end of any source range that reads
it. A transport stream that starts at 1.4 s and lasts 2 s ends at
3.4 s. Non-negative.

modified_ms.description: The file's modification time, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

MediaKind.description: The payload domain of a source.

oneOf.description: A video stream, potentially with an audio stream.
An audio stream.
A still visual image.

A picture the engine draws from the source's [`Generator`]. The host
supplies nothing for it.

A composition of the project, drawn at the source time as its own
time. The host supplies nothing for it; the media its nodes read, it
supplies as for any composition.

color_metadata.description:
The color a [`MediaKind::Video`] source's pictures are in, which wins
over what its frames and its stream are tagged with on every host: a
host records it at import, or a document declares it to correct
missing or wrong tags. `None` leaves the tags in charge. A still is
read as sRGB code values whatever it declares.

composition.description:
The composition a [`MediaKind::Composition`] source shows; present
exactly for that kind.

fingerprint.description:
What the host found at the locator when the project recorded it, so
another host can tell whether media it finds is the same. A generated
source has none.

generator.description:
What a [`MediaKind::Generated`] source draws; present exactly for
that kind.

has_audio.description:
Whether this source's media has an audio stream: a fact of the file,
so every host that imports it records the same, whether or not that
host can decode the stream. A host that cannot reports so at run time
and plays the source silent; the document keeps the stream for the
hosts that can.

[`MediaKind::Audio`] always does. A [`MediaKind::Video`] source declares
it so that clips on a visual track contribute to the mix; leaving it
unset keeps a video clip silent.

locator.description:
Opaque URI or host locator. The engine does not open it directly.
Required, except that a [`MediaKind::Generated`] or
[`MediaKind::Composition`] source has none.

provider.description:
The extension provider that supplies this source's media, and its
settings, when the host's own decoders do not read it.

MediaTime.description: A signed position or duration in timeline ticks (120 000 per second), at most the largest integer a JavaScript number holds exactly either way.

blend_mode.description: How the layer blends with the layers under it.

MissingFrames.description: How an image sequence shows a frame missing from its numbering.

oneOf.description: A sequence with a missing frame is refused.
The frame before it is shown.
Nothing is shown: a transparent frame.

NodeId.description: A stable identifier of a node within one composition graph. It has no `/`, which joins the IDs of the group and media nodes a step was drawn through.

NodeOp.description:
The operation of a [`CompositionNode`].

Animated settings are keyed in composition time (see
[`ClipComposition`]), not timeline time.

oneOf.description:
The picture of the clip showing the composition: its source at the
source time the clip's time map gives, or what its generated source
draws.

Another visual source, read at `start` plus the composition time.
A media node adds no sound to the mix.

source_id.description: The source; a video, image, or generated source.

start.description: Source time shown at composition time zero. Non-negative.

oneOf.description: A picture the engine draws.

A registered effect: its input and the named images it samples
besides.

effect.description: The versioned effect and its parameters.

input.description: The image the effect processes; a bypassed node passes it through.

inputs.description:
The images the effect samples besides its input, by the names its
definition declares (`sample_<name>` in its shader); at most
[`MAX_EFFECT_INPUTS`]. A name the definition does not declare, or
one it declares and this leaves out, fails the frames that draw
the node.

oneOf.description: A registered two-input transition at an explicit progress.

effect.description: The versioned transition and its parameters.

oneOf.description: The input placed on the canvas by a transform and opacity.

transform.description: Position, anchor, scale, rotation, and opacity.

oneOf.description: Ordered layers composited over transparency.
The input kept where a second image says.

matte.description: The image whose alpha or luminance is coverage.

mode.description: Which property of the matte image is coverage.

oneOf.description: The input kept inside shapes.

masks.description:
The shapes, combined in order; at most [`crate::MAX_CLIP_MASKS`].
Geometry is in the input image's normalized space.

oneOf.description:
Another composition drawn in this one's time, as a group: its
output, with its group inputs fed from `inputs` and its controls set
from `controls`.

controls.description:
Values for its controls, by name; a control not set keeps the
composition's own value. Keyed in composition time.

inputs.description: The image for each of its inputs, in its port order.

oneOf.description:
In a composition used as a group, the image the group node gives its
input `index`.

index.description: The input, in the composition's port order.

Overflow.description: Whether content past a box's padding box is drawn.

oneOf.description: Drawn.
Clipped to the padding box.

Paint.description:
A color or gradient.

Gradients interpolate between stops premultiplied, in linear light: the
engine's working space, so a gradient between two colors passes through
the physical mix of them, and a stop fading to transparent does not darken
its neighbour.

A color (hex or object) is read as a solid paint of it; a paint is
written back tagged.

oneOf.description: One color.
Colors along the line from `start` to `end`, constant across it.

spread.description: What lies beyond the first and last offsets.

oneOf.description: Colors along the radius of a circle.

radius.description:
The distance of offset 1 from the centre, as a fraction of the
picture's shorter side. Positive.

spread.description: What lies beyond the first and last offsets.

oneOf.description: Colors around a point: offsets 0 to 1 are one clockwise turn.

angle_degrees.description: Where offset 0 lies, in degrees clockwise from straight up.

center.description: The point the gradient turns around.

subpaths.description:
The subpaths, at most [`MAX_PATH_SUBPATHS`], with at most
[`MAX_PATH_VERTICES`] vertices among them.

PathVertex.description:
A path vertex and its tangents. The segment from vertex `a` to vertex
`b` is the cubic Bezier through `a.point`, `a.point + a.out_tangent`,
`b.point + b.in_tangent`, and `b.point`; zero tangents make it straight.

in_tangent.description: The control point of the segment ending here, relative to `point`.

out_tangent.description: The control point of the segment starting here, relative to `point`.

in_tangent.description:
The end of the way here from the previous keyframe's value, relative
to this value: that curve's second control point.

interpolation.description:
Interpolation from this keyframe to its successor: how fast the value
travels along the way there.

out_tangent.description:
The start of the way to the next keyframe's value, relative to this
value: the curve's first control point.

time.description: Timestamp of this value, as a [`Keyframe`]'s.

PolystarKind.description: What kind of figure a polystar is.

oneOf.description: Points joined by inner corners.
Points joined by straight sides.

Position.description: Whether a box is in its parent's flow.

oneOf.description: In the flow.
Out of the flow, placed by `inset`.

ProjectSettings.description: Output-wide settings independent of a renderer or encoder.

background.description:
Opaque color under every layer, in preview and export alike.

Empty canvas, and whatever shows through a translucent layer, is this
color rather than something a host or encoder decides.

blend_space.description:
The space in which clips' blend modes are evaluated, in preview and
export alike.

color.description: How sources' colors come into the working space.

height.description:
Canvas height in output pixels, at most [`MAX_CANVAS_DIMENSION`]. The
canvas area is at most [`MAX_CANVAS_PIXELS`].

width.description: Canvas width in output pixels, at most [`MAX_CANVAS_DIMENSION`].

ProviderSource.description:
A source whose media an extension provider supplies, rather than the
host's video and image decoders.

A host picks the provider by probing the bytes at import, never by a file
name, and records it here with the settings the source needs, so every
host opens the source the same way. The engine does not read it: a
provider source needs frames like any video or image source.

oneOf.description:
A static SVG document, rasterized at the size it is shown. The
source's kind is `image`.

A GIF, animated WebP, or APNG: one cycle of frames, each with its own
duration. Repetition is the clip's. The source's kind is `video`.

A Lottie animation, from a Lottie JSON file or a dotLottie package,
evaluated at its own frames. The source's kind is `video`.

animation.description:
The dotLottie animation shown, by its ID; the package's first
when absent, and absent for a Lottie JSON file.

oneOf.description:
Still images played in order at a fixed rate. The source's kind is
`video`.

frame_rate.description: The rate the frames play at.

frames.description:
Each frame's locator, in play order. `null` is a number missing
from the sequence, allowed only when `missing` says how to show
it.

missing.description: How a missing frame is shown.

primaries.description:
The primaries OpenEXR frames' linear RGB is in, overriding what
the first frame's chromaticities say. Only for OpenEXR frames.

start_number.description: The number of the first frame, as its file was numbered.

oneOf.description:
A still OpenEXR image: linear-light RGB(A), read at half precision.
The source's kind is `image`.

primaries.description:
The primaries its linear RGB is in, overriding what the file's
chromaticities say (BT.709 when it says nothing, as OpenEXR
defines).

Rgb.description:
An opaque color as a color picker shows it: straight, sRGB-encoded
components in the inclusive unit interval.

Rgba.description:
A straight (not premultiplied), sRGB-encoded color with alpha, each
component in `0..=1`.

Written as the object, or as CSS hex: `"#rgb"`, `"#rgba"`, `"#rrggbb"` or
`"#rrggbbaa"`, any case, each digit pair a component times 255. It is
written back as the object: a component need not be a multiple of 1/255.

ShapeGeometry.description: A geometry alone, as a mask's outline is.

oneOf.description: A rectangle, optionally with rounded corners.

corner_radius.description:
Corner radius, as a fraction of the shorter side. Non-negative; a
radius past half the rectangle is capped.

rotation_degrees.description: Clockwise rotation about the centre, in degrees.

size.description: Full width and height, before rotation. Non-negative.

oneOf.description: An ellipse.

rotation_degrees.description: Clockwise rotation about the centre, in degrees.

size.description: Full width and height, before rotation. Non-negative.

oneOf.description: A regular polygon or star.

inner_radius.description: A star's distance of its inner corners from the centre. Non-negative.

inner_roundness.description: How round a star's inner corners are, in `0..=1`.

outer_radius.description:
Distance of the points from the centre, as a fraction of the shorter
side. Non-negative.

outer_roundness.description:
How round the outer corners are: 0 sharp, 1 a smooth curve through
them. In `0..=1`.

points.description:
Number of points (corners of a polygon, tips of a star), from
[`MIN_POLYSTAR_POINTS`] to [`MAX_POLYSTAR_POINTS`]. A fraction is
dropped when drawn, as Lottie drops it, so an animated count changes
the figure one whole point at a time.

rotation_degrees.description: Clockwise rotation about the centre, in degrees.

oneOf.description: A Bezier path.

ShapeItem.description:
One entry of a shapes generator's content tree.

A group is read front to back. Geometry accumulates in its group; a fill
or a stroke paints the geometry listed before it in the same group,
nested groups before it included; a trim cuts that geometry and replaces
it. A paint listed earlier is drawn on top of one listed later, as in
After Effects and Lottie.

oneOf.description:
Items drawn together, through one transform and opacity. Their
geometry also counts as the enclosing group's, for the paints and
trims after the group.

transform.description: Where the group lies, and how opaque it is.

oneOf.description: A rectangle, optionally with rounded corners.

corner_radius.description:
Corner radius, as a fraction of the shorter side. Non-negative; a
radius past half the rectangle is capped.

rotation_degrees.description: Clockwise rotation about the centre, in degrees.

size.description: Full width and height, before rotation. Non-negative.

oneOf.description: An ellipse.

rotation_degrees.description: Clockwise rotation about the centre, in degrees.

size.description: Full width and height, before rotation. Non-negative.

oneOf.description: A regular polygon or star.

inner_radius.description: A star's distance of its inner corners from the centre. Non-negative.

inner_roundness.description: How round a star's inner corners are, in `0..=1`.

outer_radius.description:
Distance of the points from the centre, as a fraction of the shorter
side. Non-negative.

outer_roundness.description:
How round the outer corners are: 0 sharp, 1 a smooth curve through
them. In `0..=1`.

points.description:
Number of points (corners of a polygon, tips of a star), from
[`MIN_POLYSTAR_POINTS`] to [`MAX_POLYSTAR_POINTS`]. A fraction is
dropped when drawn, as Lottie drops it, so an animated count changes
the figure one whole point at a time.

rotation_degrees.description: Clockwise rotation about the centre, in degrees.

oneOf.description: A Bezier path.

Paints the inside of the geometry listed before it in its group, all
of it as one compound path under `rule`. An open path is closed for
it.

rule.description: Which regions of the compound path are inside.

oneOf.description: Strokes the geometry listed before it in its group.

dash.description: Dashes, or a solid stroke when absent.

miter_limit.description:
Longest a miter join reaches, as a multiple of half the width, before
it is beveled. At least 1.

width.description:
Full width, as a fraction of the shorter side. Non-negative; zero
draws nothing.

oneOf.description: Keeps part of the geometry listed before it in its group, by length.

end.description:
Where it ends, in `0..=1`. Nothing is kept unless it is after
`start`.

mode.description: Whether the span is of all the geometry together or of each part.

offset.description: Turns the span is shifted by; it wraps around a closed path.

start.description: Where the kept span starts, as a fraction of the length, in `0..=1`.

ShapeMask.description:
A shape that limits where a clip is visible.

Geometry is in the clip's source space, before its transform, so the mask
moves with the clip: `(0, 0)` is the source's top-left corner and `(1, 1)`
its bottom-right. Distances (`feather`, a rectangle's `corner_radius`, a
polystar's radii) are fractions of that space's shorter side, so a mask
covers the same part of the picture at any render resolution.

feather.description:
How soft the edge is. Non-negative; zero is the outline's
antialiased edge. The coverage is blurred by a Gaussian of standard
deviation `0.3125 * feather`, which spreads its 10 to 90 percent ramp
over `0.8 * feather` across the outline.

fill_rule.description: Which regions of the outline are inside it.

invert.description: Whether the mask keeps the outside of the shape instead of its inside.

mode.description: How this mask combines with the ones before it.

shape.description: The shape's outline, as a shapes generator's geometry.

ShapeTransform.description:
A group's placement: in pixel space, translate by `position`, rotate,
scale, and translate by minus `anchor`, so `anchor` lands on `position`.
The default leaves its items where they are.

anchor.description: The point of the items that is placed at `position`.

opacity.description:
Opacity of the group as a whole, in `0..=1`: overlapping items are
composited first and faded together.

scale.description:
Per-axis scale; 1 leaves the items unscaled. Stroke widths scale with
it.

Spread.description: What a linear or radial gradient shows outside its first and last stops.

oneOf.description: The end colors continue.
The gradient starts again.
The gradient runs back and forth.

StreamTopology.description: The streams a media file carries.

audio.description: The primary audio stream, if there is one.

video.description: The primary video stream, if there is one.

Subpath.description: A run of vertices joined by cubic Bezier segments.

closed.description: Whether a segment joins the last vertex back to the first.

TextAlign.description: How lines of text align within it.

oneOf.description: Left.
Centred.
Right.

TextBackground.description: A box behind each line of text.

padding.description:
Space between the text and the box edge, as a fraction of the font
size, in `[0, 2]`.

TextOutline.description: A band around the glyphs, drawn behind them.

width.description: Band width as a fraction of the font size, in `(0, 0.5]`.

TextStyle.description:
How text looks and where it lies: a caption track's cues, or a text
[`crate::Generator`].

Sizes are resolution-independent: the font size is a fraction of the
canvas height, the wrapping width a fraction of the canvas width, and the
outline and background padding fractions of the font size. The engine
draws with the fonts its host registered: those of `font_family` first,
then the rest in their fallback order.

align.description: How lines align within the text.

anchor.description:
The point of the text, background included, placed at
`position`: `(0.5, 1)` is its bottom centre.

font_family.description:
The family the text draws in, as the font's own name table gives it
(typographic family, else family), matched without regard to ASCII
case. Glyphs its fonts lack, and a family no registered font has,
draw from the other fonts in fallback order. `None` draws from the
fallback order alone. Non-empty, at most [`MAX_FONT_FAMILY_BYTES`]
bytes.

font_size.description:
Font size as a fraction of the canvas height: positive, at most
[`crate::MAX_CAPTION_FONT_SIZE`] on a caption track and
[`MAX_TEXT_GENERATOR_FONT_SIZE`] in a text generator.

line_height.description: Baseline-to-baseline distance in font sizes, in `[0.5, 3]`.

max_width.description: Width text wraps at, as a fraction of the canvas width, in `(0, 1]`.

position.description:
Where on the canvas the text's anchor lies, `(0, 0)` top-left to
`(1, 1)` bottom-right.

TimeMap.description:
How a clip plays its source range over its timeline range.

`forward` and `reverse` stretch the source range over the timeline range,
so their speed is the ratio of the two. A loop plays the source range at
its own speed, again and again, for as long as the timeline range lasts.

oneOf.description: From the start of the source range to its end.

From the end of the source range to its start: pictures in reverse
order and sound played backwards.
One source instant for the whole clip, and silence.

source_time.description: The instant shown; inside the source range.

oneOf.description: The source range again and again, at its own speed.

mode.description: How each pass follows the one before.

TimeScale.description: A positive rational rate of one time against another.

Timeline.description: Timeline tracks ordered from back to front for visual tracks.

Track.description: A homogeneous visual or audio timeline lane.

audio.description: Bus controls applied to this track's mixed audio.

captions.description: The cues and style of a caption track; present exactly for that kind.

clips.description:
Clips on this track. Ordering is authoring order; evaluation sorts by time.
A caption track has none.

kind.description: Controls source compatibility and evaluation behavior.

transitions.description: Explicit transitions between overlapping clips on this track.

ducking.description: Optional sidechain attenuation driven by another track.

effects.description:
Ordered single-input effects applied to the summed clip signal, at
most [`MAX_CHAIN_EFFECTS`].

gain.description: Animated linear bus amplitude constrained to `0..=MAX_GAIN`.

pan.description:
Animated stereo position applied after the clip mix, from `-1` (left)
to `1` (right).

solo.description: Restricts the mix to soloed buses when any track sets this.

TrackKind.description: The media domain accepted by a track.

oneOf.description: A composited visual track.
A mixed audio track.
Timed text, drawn over the tracks before it and under the ones after.

TrackList.description: A grid track list as CSS writes it: "1fr 2fr 120px", "repeat(3, minmax(100px, 1fr))", "repeat(auto-fill, 160px)", "auto min-content max-content", "fit-content(200px)". A bare number is a fraction of the picture's shorter side. Named lines are not supported.

oneOf.description: BT.709 opto-electronic transfer function.
IEC sRGB transfer function.
Perceptual quantizer HDR transfer function.
Hybrid log-gamma HDR transfer function.
One span over the length of every subpath end to end, in order.
A span of each subpath alone.

Vec2.description: A two-dimensional value in normalized output coordinates.

VideoStreamShape.description: A video stream's displayed size and frame rate.

frame_rate.description:
The rate its first frames are presented at, as every host measures
it from packet times and rounds it (`alpha2_assets::FrameRateEvidence`),
when it can be measured. Not the rate a stream declares: a declared
rate is a guess for variable-rate media, and browsers report none.

height.description:
Displayed height in square pixels: the stored height stretched by a
pixel aspect ratio taller than wide, then turned.

width.description:
Displayed width in square pixels: the stored width stretched by a
pixel aspect ratio wider than tall, then turned by the stream's
orientation.

VisualProperties.description: Resolution-independent visual presentation controls for a clip.

anchor.description: Unanimated normalized point within the source rectangle.

position.description:
Animated normalized canvas translation, along spatial curves where its
keyframes have tangents.

description:
The deserialized shape of a [`Project`], before its invariants are checked.

This is the wire contract, and the published JSON Schema is derived from
it: a document the schema accepts has the right shape, and
[`Project::validate`] then decides whether it means anything.

audio.description: Master bus applied to the summed track audio.

effect_resources.description: Non-media resources referenced by effect invocations.

name.description: Human-readable project name. It has no semantic meaning.

schema_version.description:
Document version. This build reads and writes only
[`CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION`].
